name: More saturated colours raise arousal

direction.note: The Munsell range is the usual chip range, not a value from the paper.

claim: Colour saturation predicted arousal most, and dominance and pleasure less, in the same study as the brightness cue.
caveat: Colour chips, not rooms; the weights (arousal .60, dominance .32, pleasure .22) come from a quoted abstract and need a check against the paper.

sources.title: Valdez and Mehrabian 1994, Effects of color on emotions, Journal of Experimental Psychology: General 123(4)
